passages.text: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mobilized the house of Judah and Benjamin—180,000 chosen warriors—to fight against Israel and restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was the king of Judah.
He arrived in Jerusalem.
He gathered the people from the tribe of Judah.
He also gathered the people from the tribe of Benjamin.
He chose 180,000 strong young men.
These men were ready for war.
Rehoboam prepared them to fight against Israel.
He wanted to bring the kingdom back under his rule.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א רְחַבְעָם֮ יְרוּשָׁלִַם֒ וַיַּקְהֵל֩ אֶת־ בֵּ֨ית יְהוּדָ֜ה וּבִנְיָמִ֗ן מֵאָ֨ה וּשְׁמוֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף בָּח֖וּר עֹשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָ֑ה לְהִלָּחֵם֙ עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־ הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה לִרְחַבְעָֽם׃פ

passages.text: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God: “Tell Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and all the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin that this is what the LORD says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers. Each of you must return home, for this word is from Me.’ ” So they listened to the words of the LORD and turned back from going against Jeroboam.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Shemaiah.
Shemaiah was a man of God.
The LORD gave Shemaiah a message.
The LORD said, “Speak to Rehoboam.”
Rehoboam was the son of Solomon.
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
The LORD said, “Speak to all the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin.”
The LORD said, “This is what I command.”
The LORD said, “Do not go up to fight against your brothers.”
The LORD said, “Each of you must return to his home.”
The LORD said, “This command comes from Me.”
The people heard the words of the LORD.
They obeyed the LORD.
They turned back from marching against Jeroboam.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥הוּ אִישׁ־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵאמֹֽר׃ אֱמֹ֕ר אֶל־ רְחַבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶל֙ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּיהוּדָ֥ה וּבִנְיָמִ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה לֹא־ תַעֲלוּ֩ וְלֹא־ תִלָּ֨חֲמ֜וּ עִם־ אֲחֵיכֶ֗ם שׁ֚וּבוּ אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֔וֹ כִּ֧י מֵֽאִתִּ֛י נִהְיָ֖ה הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ מִלֶּ֥כֶת אֶל־ יָרָבְעָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Rehoboam continued to live in Jerusalem, and he built up cities for defense in Judah.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was the king of Judah.
He lived in Jerusalem.
He stayed in Jerusalem.
He built cities in Judah.
He made these cities strong for defense.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב רְחַבְעָ֖ם בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיִּ֧בֶן עָרִ֛ים לְמָצ֖וֹר בִּיהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: He built up Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa, Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam, Gath, Mareshah, Ziph, Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah, Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, the fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
He lived in Jerusalem.
He built up cities for defense in Judah and Benjamin.
He built Bethlehem.
He built Etam.
He built Tekoa.
He built Beth-zur.
He built Soco.
He built Adullam.
He built Gath.
He built Mareshah.
He built Ziph.
He built Adoraim.
He built Lachish.
He built Azekah.
He built Zorah.
He built Aijalon.
He built Hebron.
All these cities were fortified.
All these cities were in Judah and Benjamin.
passages.original: וַיִּ֧בֶן אֶת־ בֵּֽית־ לֶ֛חֶם וְאֶת־ עֵיטָ֖ם וְאֶת־ תְּקֽוֹעַ׃ וְאֶת־ בֵּֽית־ צ֥וּר וְאֶת־ שׂוֹכ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ עֲדֻלָּֽם׃ וְאֶת־ גַּ֥ת וְאֶת־ מָרֵשָׁ֖ה וְאֶת־ זִֽיף׃ וְאֶת־ אֲדוֹרַ֥יִם וְאֶת־ לָכִ֖ישׁ וְאֶת־ עֲזֵקָֽה׃ וְאֶת־ צָרְעָה֙ וְאֶת־ אַיָּל֔וֹן וְאֶת־ חֶבְר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּיהוּדָ֖ה וּבְבִנְיָמִ֑ן עָרֵ֖י מְצֻרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: He strengthened their fortresses and put officers in them, with supplies of food, oil, and wine.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king in Jerusalem.
He built and strengthened the fortresses in Judah and Benjamin.
He put officers in each fortress.
He stored food in the fortresses.
He stored oil in the fortresses.
He stored wine in the fortresses.
passages.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֖ק אֶת־ הַמְּצֻר֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֤ן בָּהֶם֙ נְגִידִ֔ים וְאֹצְר֥וֹת מַאֲכָ֖ל וְשֶׁ֥מֶן וָיָֽיִן׃

passages.text: He also put shields and spears in all the cities and strengthened them greatly. So Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king.
He ruled over Judah and Benjamin.
He put shields in every city.
He put spears in every city.
He made the cities very strong.
Judah belonged to Rehoboam.
Benjamin belonged to Rehoboam.
passages.original: וּבְכָל־ עִ֤יר וָעִיר֙ צִנּ֣וֹת וּרְמָחִ֔ים וַֽיְחַזְּקֵ֖ם לְהַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַיְהִי־ ל֖וֹ יְהוּדָ֥ה וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃ס

passages.text: Moreover, the priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel stood with Rehoboam.
passages.sermon: The priests and the Levites lived in every part of Israel.\r\nThey came from all their districts.\r\nThey stood with Rehoboam.
passages.original: וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִֽתְיַצְּב֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מִכָּל־ גְּבוּלָֽם׃

passages.text: For the Levites left their pasturelands and their possessions and went to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a tribe in Israel.
The Levites served as priests of the LORD.
Jeroboam was king over Israel.
Jeroboam had sons.
Jeroboam and his sons rejected the Levites as priests of the LORD.
The Levites left their pasturelands.
The Levites left their possessions.
The Levites went to Judah.
The Levites went to Jerusalem.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ עָזְב֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֶת־ מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶם֙ וַאֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ לִיהוּדָ֖ה וְלִֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּֽי־ הִזְנִיחָ֤ם יָֽרָבְעָם֙ וּבָנָ֔יו מִכַּהֵ֖ן לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And Jeroboam appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat demons and calf idols he had made.
passages.sermon:
Jeroboam was king in Israel.
Jeroboam made idols.
He made goat demons.
He made calf idols.
Jeroboam built high places for worship.
He appointed his own priests.
These priests served at the high places.
These priests served the goat demons.
These priests served the calf idols Jeroboam made.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעֲמֶד־ לוֹ֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים לַבָּמ֖וֹת וְלַשְּׂעִירִ֑ים וְלָעֲגָלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃

passages.text: Those from every tribe of Israel who had set their hearts to seek the LORD their God followed the Levites to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
passages.sermon:
People from every tribe of Israel chose to seek the LORD their God.
These people set their hearts on finding Him.
They followed the Levites.
They went to Jerusalem.
They went there to offer sacrifices to the LORD.
The LORD is the God of their fathers.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַנֹּֽתְנִים֙ אֶת־ לְבָבָ֔ם לְבַקֵּ֕שׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בָּ֚אוּ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִזְבּ֕וֹחַ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon for three years, because they walked for three years in the way of David and Solomon.
passages.sermon:
The people strengthened the kingdom of Judah.
They supported Rehoboam.
Rehoboam was the son of Solomon.
They did this for three years.
They walked in the way of David and Solomon for three years.
passages.original: וַֽיְחַזְּקוּ֙ אֶת־ מַלְכ֣וּת יְהוּדָ֔ה וַֽיְאַמְּצ֛וּ אֶת־ רְחַבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְשָׁנִ֣ים שָׁל֑וֹשׁ כִּ֣י הָֽלְכ֗וּ בְּדֶ֧רֶךְ דָּוִ֛יד וּשְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְשָׁנִ֥ים שָׁלֽוֹשׁ׃

passages.text: And Rehoboam married Mahalath, who was the daughter of David’s son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Jesse’s son Eliab.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was the king of Judah.
Rehoboam took a wife.
He married Mahalath.
Mahalath was the daughter of Jerimoth.
Jerimoth was the son of David.
Mahalath’s mother was Abihail.
Abihail was the daughter of Eliab.
Eliab was the son of Jesse.
passages.original: וַיִּֽקַּֽח־ ל֤וֹ רְחַבְעָם֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת־ מָ֣חֲלַ֔ת בֶּן יְרִימ֖וֹת בֶּן־ דָּוִ֑יד אֲבִיהַ֕יִל בַּת־ אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־ יִשָֽׁי׃

passages.text: She bore sons to him: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
passages.sermon: Mahalath was Rehoboam’s wife.\r\nMahalath gave birth to sons for Rehoboam.\r\nTheir sons were Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֥לֶד ל֖וֹ בָּנִ֑ים אֶת־ יְע֥וּשׁ וְאֶת־ שְׁמַרְיָ֖ה וְאֶת־ זָֽהַם׃

passages.text: After her, he married Maacah daughter of Absalom, and she bore to him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
He married Maacah.
Maacah was the daughter of Absalom.
Maacah became Rehoboam’s wife after his marriage to Mahalath.
Maacah gave birth to four children for Rehoboam.
Their children were Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
passages.original: וְאַחֲרֶ֣יהָ לָקַ֔ח אֶֽת־ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת־ אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַתֵּ֣לֶד ל֗וֹ אֶת־ אֲבִיָּה֙ וְאֶת־ עַתַּ֔י וְאֶת־ זִיזָ֖א וְאֶת־ שְׁלֹמִֽית׃

passages.text: Rehoboam loved Maacah daughter of Absalom more than all his wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and he was the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
Rehoboam had many wives and concubines.
He had eighteen wives.
He had sixty concubines.
Rehoboam loved Maacah.
Maacah was the daughter of Absalom.
Rehoboam loved Maacah more than all his other wives and concubines.
Rehoboam became the father of twenty-eight sons.
He also became the father of sixty daughters.
passages.original: וַיֶּאֱהַ֨ב רְחַבְעָ֜ם אֶת־ מַעֲכָ֣ה בַת־ אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם מִכָּל־ נָשָׁיו֙ וּפִ֣ילַגְשָׁ֔יו כִּ֠י נָשִׁ֤ים שְׁמוֹנֶֽה־ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ נָשָׂ֔א וּפִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֑ים וַיּ֗וֹלֶד עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֛ה בָּנִ֖ים וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים בָּנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maacah as chief prince among his brothers, intending to make him king.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
Rehoboam had many sons.
Maacah was one of Rehoboam’s wives.
Abijah was the son of Maacah.
Rehoboam chose Abijah.
Rehoboam made Abijah chief prince over his brothers.
Rehoboam planned to make Abijah king.
passages.original: וַיַּֽעֲמֵ֨ד לָרֹ֧אשׁ רְחַבְעָ֛ם אֶת־ אֲבִיָּ֥ה בֶֽן־ מַעֲכָ֖ה לְנָגִ֣יד בְּאֶחָ֑יו כִּ֖י לְהַמְלִיכֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Rehoboam also acted wisely by dispersing some of his sons throughout the districts of Judah and Benjamin, and to all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and sought many wives for them.
passages.sermon:
Rehoboam was king of Judah.
He had many sons.
He sent some of his sons to different regions of Judah and Benjamin.
He placed them in all the fortified cities.
He gave his sons plenty of food and supplies.
He found many wives for his sons.
passages.original: וַיָּבֶן֩ וַיִּפְרֹ֨ץ מִכָּל־ בָּנָ֜יו לְֽכָל־ אַרְצ֧וֹת יְהוּדָ֣ה וּבִנְיָמִ֗ן לְכֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַמְּצֻר֔וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֥ן לָהֶ֛ם הַמָּז֖וֹן לָרֹ֑ב וַיִּשְׁאַ֖ל הֲמ֥וֹן נָשִֽׁים׃
